To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the monetary policy transmission mechanism is similar across economies, with a lagged effect of the policy interest rate on output of about 1 year; (2) the monetary policy reaction function is similar across economies; (3) the effects of monetary policy on the exchange rate are small and short-lived; (4) monetary policy is effective in reducing inflation; and (5) the model is useful for forecasting and policy analysis.
